description: Last week, I was proud to send two childcare bills to the governor’s desk. The first, HB1567, reduces regulatory barriers for entrepreneurs seeking to open small, in-home childcare businesses. Stimulating the development of these categories of care is one of best levers we have to ease our crisis in the availability of care over the […]
